The Calder & Wynne engagement letter is addressed to Petra Voss, General Counsel of Voss-Lindqvist AB.

[1]

evidence.quote: To: Petra Voss, General Counsel, Voss-Lindqvist AB — 5 February 2026

items.question: On what date was the service credit side letter signed?
items.answer:
The service credit side letter was signed on 28 March 2026.

This is stated in the text: "*Signed for Harrowgate Systems Inc. and agreed by Voss-Lindqvist AB on 28 March 2026 (fictional).*" [2]

evidence.quote: *Signed for Harrowgate Systems Inc. and agreed by Voss-Lindqvist AB on 28 March 2026 (fictional).*

items.question: How much of Harrowgate is Pellucid Holdings acquiring?
items.answer: The documents do not specify the percentage of Harrowgate Systems Inc. that Pellucid Holdings plc is acquiring. The Change of Control notice states that Pellucid Holdings plc has agreed to acquire all of the shares of Harrowgate Systems Inc. [1]. However, the documents do not provide the specific percentage of the company being acquired.

evidence.quote: Pellucid Holdings plc has agreed to acquire all of the shares of Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: Under which clause of the MSA was the change of control notice given?
items.answer: The change of control notice was given under Clause 14.2 of the MSA. The notice states, "We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc." [2].

evidence.quote: We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: Does the Kestrel storage agreement have a fixed end date?
items.answer: The Kestrel storage agreement does not have a fixed end date. Clause 5.1 states that the agreement "continues until terminated," and Clause 5.2 allows either party to terminate the agreement with 60 days' written notice [1][1].

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated
Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer: The terms of the storage agreement that remain in force after Amendment No. 1 include all terms except for the amended clause. The document states, "2.2 All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force" [1].

evidence.quote: 2.2 All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: How sure is Jonas Ekberg of the time the alarm sounded?
items.answer: Jonas Ekberg stated that he recalls the temperature alarm sounding at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026 but added that he is not sure of the exact minute [1].

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute.

items.question: What was the Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1?
items.answer: The Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1 was EUR 4,000. This is stated in the original Kestrel Storage Services Agreement [2].
